name: invoice-system
description: I3PL Dispatch Invoice System - A comprehensive logistics dispatch and invoice management solution
author: I3PL India Pvt Ltd

scripts.electron:build-main: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist-electron')) fs.mkdirSync('dist-electron'); fs.writeFileSync('dist-electron/package.json', JSON.stringify({type: 'commonjs'}))"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "tsc -w -p tsconfig.electron.json" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electronmon ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run electron:build-main && electron-builder
